verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a CLI package manager, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. The only documented interface is the CLI manpage, which is not an MCP server and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
